bug_info.bug_desc: In the CSR privilege-check logic, a lower-privilege CSR access made while executing in virtualized mode is classified as a virtual privilege violation only when the CSR's required privilege level is exactly HS. This misses supervisor-level CSRs, whose required privilege level is below HS, so accesses such as a VU-mode access to an S-level CSR can be reported as an ordinary illegal instruction instead of a virtual instruction exception.
bug_info.fix_hint: In the CSR privilege-check logic, replace the exact HS-level comparison with a comparison that also includes CSR privilege levels below HS. This makes supervisor-level CSR privilege violations in virtualized mode raise the virtual instruction exception path instead of the ordinary illegal-instruction path.
